title: $σ$-hereditarily closure-preserving $\mathcal I$-$sn$-networks, $\mathcal I$-$sn$-metrizability, and local HCP-finiteness
summary: Let $\mathcal I$ be an admissible ideal on $\mathbb N$. Zhou, Liu, Liu, and Lin asked whether every regular space with a $σ$-hereditarily closure-preserving $\mathcal I$-$sn$-network is $\mathcal I$-$sn$-metrizable. The answer is affirmative for every admissible ideal. The proof rests on a local countability theorem. If $y_n\to_{\mathcal I}x$ and $\{n\mid y_n\ne x\}\in\mathcal I^+$, then every point-discrete family of $\mathcal I$-sequential neighborhoods of $x$ is countable.
